name: ambiguous-commit-blind-retry
description: COMMIT submitted, acknowledgment lost, the client cannot tell whether PostgreSQL committed, and retries blindly (a fresh row per attempt). Phase 8 could only model a crash before or after the COMMIT; here the server's outcome is a separate physical fact the client does not know.
